meta.name: lark-workflow-meeting-summary
meta.description: 会议纪要整理工作流：汇总指定时间范围内的会议纪要并生成结构化报告。当用户需要整理会议纪要、生成会议周报、回顾一段时间内的会议内容时使用。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按时间段汇总会议纪要并生成结构化报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你常需整理团队会议记录并定期产出摘要
copy.tagline_en: Summarize meeting notes into a structured report for a time range
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to compile meeting notes into reports

howto.what: 安装后，Claude会按用户给出的时间范围（默认7天）查询飞书会议，读取相关纪要，生成单日概览或多日周报等结构化报告，含会议时间、主题及纪要/逐字稿链接；需要时可创建或追加云文档。
howto.when: 当用户要求整理会议纪要、生成会议周报或回顾一定时期的会议内容时触发，如说“今天”“这周”等时间表述。

say.text: 帮我整理这周的会议纪要
say.note: 会按多日周报格式汇总会议并列出链接

say.text: 看看今天开了哪些会，输出会议概览
say.note: 会生成今日会议概览，含纪要链接

say.text: 回顾上周的会议内容，给我一份总结报告
say.note: 会按上周时间范围查询并整理为周报

howto.what_en: Upon request, Claude searches Lark meetings in a given time range (default 7 days), reads related minutes, and produces a daily overview or multi-day weekly report with meeting time, topic, and document links; it can also create or append a cloud document.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to organize meeting minutes, generate a weekly report, or review meetings over a period, e.g., saying "today" or "this week".

say_en.text: Compile this week's meeting minutes into a weekly report.
say_en.note: Triggers a weekly summary with links.

say_en.text: What meetings happened today? Show a daily overview.
Review last week's meetings and give me a summary.
say_en.note: Queries last week and returns a weekly report.
